newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to price floating rate notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to price floating rate notes.

text.p: Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday that it will price $600 million of short-term floating rate notes on Monday, March 10.
When-issued trading is expected to begin at 0820 EST/1320 GMT) the following day, it said.
The notes are for settlement March 13. Maturity date is Sept 18, 1997. Cusip number is 86387TFA1.
Sallie Mae said the notes will be priced at a spread to the bond equivalent rate of the 91-day Treasury bill, with the interest rate reset the day after each weekly T-bill auction.
